<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template for reducing a nitro group to a primary amine, I will search the template catalog using the valid functional group names: “nitro” as the broken group and “primary amines” as the formed group. This should return templates that perform the desired transformation, including their IDs and mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(Cl)(=O)C1=CC(F)=CC=C1.Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
